data.name: Nepal
data.gender_notes: Nepal is used as a neutral name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nepal is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Nepa' meaning lord or ruler and 'Alaya' meaning home. The name is a reflection of the belief that the land is the home of various gods and goddesses. The name Nepal carries the meaning “Home of the Gods” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Geographical name tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nepal usually hope their child will grow to embody home of the gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The name Nepal itself beautifully encapsulates the concept of this mystical land being the ruling abode of numerous gods and goddesses.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Nepal holds deep spiritual significance for Hindus. Nepal is considered a sacred place in Hinduism, as it is believed that many gods reside in its mountains and rivers. The spiritual significance of the name Nepal is also reflected in its flag, which bears the symbols of the Sun and the Moon, representing Lord Shiva and the Goddess Parvati respectively.
